title: Offline LLM energy use
gist: A measured cost-per-token analysis of running a model on a high-end laptop against buying the same model through an API aggregator.
changes: Puts local at parity in the best case and about ten times dearer in the worst, with the hardware's depreciation, not electricity, as the dominant cost.
caveats: One machine and one author's assumptions about depreciation and utilisation. The title is taken from the URL; check the page for its exact wording.

numbers.metric: Cost per million tokens on an M5 Max
numbers.baseline: $0.38 to $0.50 for the same model via OpenRouter

bears_on.note: Owned hardware is at best cost-neutral per token before any loop is run on it.
